stories.summary: Anti-Ukrainian sentiment in Poland is on the rise, with numerous attacks against refugees from the war in Ukraine. Prime Minister Donald Tusk has spoken out against the violence and warned of the danger from Russia.

The liberal-conservative prime minister said he deplored the fact that "more and more such incidents" are taking place all over Poland . Tusk's comments came in response to an incident in Wroclaw two days earlier, in which three Polish men brutally beat up a young Ukrainian man and his girlfriend on the street. Cellphone videos show the attackers kicking the Ukrainian man as he lies on the ground. The woman was also hit, sustaining injuries to her neck and ear. stories.article_text_excerpt: Crowds line Amsterdam's canals for Pride boat parade Crowds line Amsterdam's canals for Pride boat parade Close Amsterdam came alive with music, colour and celebration on Saturday, as thousands of people flocked to the canals to watch the city's annual Pride boat parade. The Dutch capital is hosting this years' WorldPride event, drawing visitors from across the world. Costumed participants danced and waved from a colourful flotilla of 80 decorated vessels as they made their way through the city's waterways. Security was visibly heightened at the event, with police cruising the canals in motorboats. The measures come just a week after a deadly attack on a Pride event in Berlin, which killed one person and injured at least 29 others. Sajtóértesülések szerint Pastore-t a Bronxbn található otthonában találták meg, és semmi nem utal idegenkezűségre. A Maffiózókban Pastore Tony Soprano legjobb barátját játszotta, aki végül az FBI informátora lett. Karakterének halála a második évad egyik legemlékezetesebb történetszála volt. Pastore 1946-ban született a New York-i Bronxban. A vietnámi háború idején belépett az amerikai haditengerészethez, majd később színészi karrierbe kezdett. Játszott a Nagymenőkben (Goodfellas) és a Carlito útjában (Carlito's Way), majd az Esküdt ellenségek, a General Hospital és a Hawaii Five-O sorozatokban is feltűnt.
